input:
You are king_e1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 17. the team planned Ke1 (king_e1), but queen_d1 (greed) sent Qxd5 instead, and that move was played, costing 762 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 4. the team planned b3 (pawn_b2), but pawn_b2 (amnesia) sent b4 instead, and that move was played, costing 87 centipawns.
- On move 15. the team planned Qb3 (queen_d1), but rook_a1 (greed) sent Rxa6 instead, and that move was played, costing 387 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send a move only if your piece is the one named and the move matches the plan exactly (same destination square); if the plan names a different piece or move, stay silent, and do not deviate for captures or threats unless the team agrees in chat.
- Only the piece named in the latest agreed plan may send a move, and only that exact move to that exact destination square; every other agent must stay silent, even if its piece is attacked or can capture something, unless the team has explicitly agreed in chat to change the plan, and if the named piece finds itself about to send anything different it must re-read the plan and send the planned move instead.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending any move, every agent must check that the chat's latest plan names its own piece and exact destination square, and if it does not, stay silent: a capture that looks free, a threat against your piece, or a mistaken memory of the plan is never a reason to send a move, and if the plan seems wrong, say so in chat and wait for the team to agree on a new plan.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
